{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Calculate response rate per site
response_rate_per_site = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean() * 100

# Find the site with the highest response rate
highest_site = response_rate_per_site.idxmax()
highest_rate = response_rate_per_site.max()

print(f"Response rates by site:")
print(response_rate_per_site.round(2))
print(f"\nSite with highest response rate: {highest_site} ({highest_rate:.2f}%)")"}
